lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately five staggered horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a repeating grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice structure where the blobs act as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient showing high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs is concentrated at the posterior base and along the anterior margin of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, thin linear feature or tether is visible trailing from the posterior margin near the base of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible, with one prominent individual attached to the lower lateral flank and another swimming near the ventral-caudal region.
